Thanks for the context, Dylan — this is straightforward. Below is the standard playbook we use for Coupa/PR requests and supplier onboarding. I attached our Redwood-facing onboarding PDF and a completed W9.

Redwood playbook (concise):
1) Create internal procurement ticket (PR intake) in Jira: PROC-INTAKE > select template "Supplier Onboarding" and tag deal RDW-2389. Set priority: Normal.
2) Prepare supplier packet (attach to Jira ticket):
   - Redwood Supplier Form (we fill legal name, tax id, remit address)
   - Redwood_W9.pdf (attached)
   - SOC2 summary (redacted) or link to our compliance page (if they require evidence)
   - Short SOW (1 page) describing pilot scope, term, and expected spend range
3) Supplier mapping fields to include (Coupa common fields):
   - Legal Name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Doing Business As (optional): Redwood
   - Tax ID / EIN: 12-3456789
   - Remit Address: 123 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105
   - Primary contact email: finance-payments@redwood.com
   - Supplier Category: SaaS / ML Inference
   - Payment Term: Net 30 (Default, we can accept PO with Net 30)

Notes on bank details: We do NOT include bank account info in Coupa onboarding forms. Finance will add payment instructions after the PO is issued.

Templates & ownership:
- Sales Ops (Marissa): prepare supplier packet + SOW draft and attach to Jira PROC-INTAKE.
- Finance (Ben): review ticket and confirm tax ID, W9 and payment terms.
- Sales AE (Dylan): get procurement intro from Stellar (Samir), confirm PR timeline, and monitor Jira ticket until supplier record created.

Suggested message to send to Stellar procurement when you (Dylan) have the ticket ready:
"Hi Samir — per Laura, we've opened an internal supplier onboarding request (Jira PROC-INTAKE-####) and attached Redwood's W9 and short SOW. Could you confirm the Coupa supplier fields you need and whether you prefer we complete Stellar's vendor form or use Coupa-native fields?"
